## AC / DoD matrix

| Acceptance criterion | Required completion evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Items listed in the ledger's `verifiedItems` are ticked before composition, and the round posts `clean` when nothing else blocks. | An `upsert-checkpoint-verdict` test seeds a PR body with 22 unchecked items and a `clean` ledger whose `verifiedItems` lists all 22, and asserts one PR-body edit ticks all 22 and the posted verdict is `clean`. |
| Items not listed are never ticked and still block. | A test with `verifiedItems` listing 20 of 22 asserts exactly those 20 are ticked and the verdict is `blocked` naming the other 2. |
| The tick runs only where it is safe. | Tests assert: no tick for `draft_gate`; no tick without `--findings-ledger`; a failed PR-body edit posts no verdict and exits nonzero; the later `clean` guard reads the reloaded artifact. |
| Reviewers for the AC angles are told to emit `verifiedItems`, in every unit shape. | An `emit-fanout-dispatch` test asserts the suffix contains the instruction for a unit carrying `acceptance-criteria` or `pr-checklist`, including a packed unit (ADR 0095) that holds one of them with other angles; a unit carrying neither lacks it; the work order stays under `REVIEWER_WORK_ORDER_MAX_BYTES`. |
| Fan-in validates the field and carries it to the durable ledger. | `gate-fanin` tests reject a non-array value, an empty entry, and the field on another angle; `consolidate-fanin` and `write-gate-findings-log` tests assert a valid union reaches the durable ledger and a carried or synthetic entry adds nothing; the existing `provenance.dispatchUnits` pairing tests pass unchanged. |
| The blockers line shows counts per kind, with every remaining item in a collapsed block. | Rendering tests assert the counts line has no criterion text and the `<details>` block lists every remaining item once with no "+N more"; the existing blocker-format assertions in `test/github/upsert-checkpoint-verdict.test.mjs` are updated to the new form. |
| The procedure docs describe the automatic tick and keep one rule home. | `acceptance-criteria-verification.md` steps 5 to 7, the acceptance-criteria bullet in `skills/copilot-pr-followup/SKILL.md`, and the `pre_approval_gate` next-action row in `gate-review-sub-loop-contract.md` describe the automatic tick with no second manual rule; `agents/review.agent.md` documents `verifiedItems`; `.claude` is regenerated and the `claude-assets-reproducible` test passes. |
| A new ADR records the decision. | A new ADR (Reserved ADR number: 0100 (tentative; renumber at merge if taken, per ADR-PATH-NUMBERING)) with Status `Accepted` records that reviewer output drives the gate tick and states that it amends no ADR; the bodies of ADR 0059, 0078, 0089 and 0095 are unchanged; `test:docs` passes. |
| This issue runs first after #2414 merges, before #2448. | The PR's base contains the #2414 merge commit and no #2448 merge. The diff adds no #2448 change: no `specificity` field and no emitter continuation mode. |
| The repo stays green. | Verdict-comment parsing and `detect-checkpoint-evidence` tests pass unchanged; `env -u DEVLOOPS_RUN_ID bun run verify` is green. |
